english: Such attempts as — I shall learn from teachers and scriptures what in this world is of worth and what is worthless'—is the stage of endeavour. The separating, out of the defects that were present in the mind which have ripened by the exercise of discrimination from those that are yet to ripen, is the stage of analysis. When enjoying objects is given up with the understanding that all such enjoyments of objects, whether seen or heard, are miserable, only the longing remains in the mind; such thirstless state is the uni-sense stage of non-attachment.270 Complete non-attachment is named the stage of subjugation. Therefore, the lower kind of non-attachment--aparam vairāgyam-being the promoter of eight-limbed yoga, forms the internal means to the conscious variety of concentration, but it is external to superconscious concentration.
